CA.rationale: No explicit attention/processing condition linked to identified content organization/presentation/access.

COD.rationale: Content (red) is identified with coordinate organization and an explicitly separate origin/status field for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing condition linked to the identified content's organization/access.

C.rationale: Multiple entries explicitly list identified contents (colors) with attributes (coordinate sets) in current and candidate records.

D.rationale: The report separates content identity (color coordinate lists) from an explicit origin/status field for the same content referent/time.

O.rationale: The report states how contents are presented as coordinate sets and describes origin/representation status for current and candidate records.
